elements.label: Presenter walking through office
elements.change_other: live-action subject motion (walking, slight head turn)

sfx_review.label: chime
sfx_review.note: Tonal onset with sustained low harmonic band just before the burst; reads as a soft musical chime/pad, not tied to an on-screen action.

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Falls ~616 ms after the event; tonal band continuation, could be score rather than a discrete SFX.

pattern.description: Live-action footage: a presenter walks through an open-plan office toward camera; the only motion is natural subject movement inside a static frame.
pattern.why_premium: Cinematic letterboxed live-action with shallow depth and soft practical lighting grounds the abstract AI topic in a real workplace before the UI demo.

build_hint.gsap: Not a graphic animation: place the footage clip on a timeline track (e.g. tl.set(video, {autoAlpha: 1}) at shot start) and let it play; no tweened properties. Optional subtle letterbox bars held static.
build_hint.remotion: <OffthreadVideo> inside a <Sequence> for the shot duration; no interpolate/spring needed, letterbox via static black <AbsoluteFill> bars.

notes: Camera verdict is none; the small pan/scale sums come from the subject walking inside the frame, not a camera move. Energy burst is very short (~130 ms) and is just a slice of continuous live-action motion.
